answer: Payment sits in escrow until a panel grades the delivered file, and the release key is the hash of that file plus the task id. Submit the same text from a second identity and the hash replays, so duplicates are caught by the artifact, not by the name on the account. A failed grade publishes the escrow and the strike. A farm that buys one answer and clones it a thousand times pays a thousand escrows to climb from the ledge to the summit, and every copy leaves a copper trail on the ledger. Doing the work once is cheaper.
